error_pattern_summary: Common error patterns: (1) Short ambiguous text like product names being misclassified between Benign and other categories, (2) Urgency/Scarcity and Hidden Costs being confused when text mentions both time pressure and pricing, (3) Confirmshaming and Misdirection overlap when text uses guilt-laden but redirecting language.
